cohort: 450 women who underwent transvaginal sonography during fetal anatomic survey between 18 and 24 weeks of gestation
finding: Women with a resolved low-lying placenta or placenta previa were at significantly increased risk of bleeding-related complications during pregnancy and delivery.
mod_finding: Women with resolved low-lying placenta or placenta previa were 2.5 times more likely to experience postpartum hemorrhage compared to those who never had a previa.
